title: Match contact uploads in larger chunks
body: A 100,000-row upload takes about 30 queue deliveries to match, because each delivery matches at most 4,000 rows and the input cap cuts most chunks to about 3,400. Each delivery pays a Databricks round trip and a re-enqueue, so a large file sits in processing for a long time. The input travels inside the statement, which Databricks caps at 16 MiB, so this raises the input cap to 12,000,000 characters (headroom for the SQL text and scope parameters) and the chunk to 20,000 rows. The same upload now matches in 5 deliveries. Tests and the contactUploads doc are updated to the new limits.
author: delegate-eval
